title: Supraglacial Lake Fate Is Knowable Long Before the Season Ends
abstract: arXiv:2608.30113v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A supraglacial lake on the Greenland Ice Sheet ends its melt season in one of four ways: it drains rapidly through a hydrofracture, drains slowly across the surface, refreezes in place, or is buried by late-season snowfall. Which one occurs decides whether the meltwater reaches the ice bed. Satellite classifiers recover the outcome accurately but only after the season closes, and how much of a season each outcome actually requires has never been measured. We measure it directly: holding the representation and the classifier fixed, we truncate the input at $14$ cutoffs from 1 May to 31 December, retrain at each, and record the earliest cutoff at which each outcome's per-class $F_1$ reaches a fixed target. The outcomes resolve in a consistent order, two of them months early: rapid drainage by 15 July and slow drainage by 1 August, $92$ and $75$ days ahead of the earliest date a full-season pipeline can be computed at all, with buried and r

translated_title: 冰面湖的命运在消融季结束前很久即可知晓
translated_abstract: 格陵兰冰盖上的冰面湖以四种方式之一结束其消融季：通过水力压裂快速排空、沿冰面缓慢排空、原地重新冻结，或被季末降雪掩埋。发生哪一种结局决定了融水能否到达冰床。卫星分类器能够准确恢复结局，但只有在消融季结束之后才行，而每种结局实际上需要多长的观测季节从未被测量过。我们直接测量了这一点：在保持表征和分类器固定不变的情况下，我们将输入在从5月1日到12月31日的14个截断点上截断，在每个截断点重新训练，并记录每种结局的每类F1分数达到固定目标时的最早截断点。各结局以一致的顺序显现，其中两种提前数月即可确定：快速排水在7月15日前、缓慢排水在8月1日前即可判定，分别比全季流程最早可计算的日期提前92天和75天，而掩埋和重冻结……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过在消融季不同时间点截断卫星输入数据并重新训练固定分类器，首次量化了格陵兰冰盖冰面湖四种结局（快速排水、缓慢排水、重冻结、掩埋）各需多长的观测季节才能确定，发现快速排水和缓慢排水可分别提前至7月15日和8月1日判定，比传统全季方法提前92天和75天。
en_tdlr: By truncating satellite inputs at 14 cutoff dates and retraining a fixed classifier, this study directly measures how much of the melt season each supraglacial lake outcome requires, showing that rapid drainage is knowable by 15 July and slow drainage by 1 August—92 and 75 days earlier than a full-season pipeline allows.
